title: Unified Explosion VFX Across Games & Lab

steps.title: Before / After & Perf
steps.body: Per-game before/after contact sheets (Getaway propane & car, Blackout frag & wreck, Carrier ship hit, airburst & boat) and Apple Metal 60 Hz budget table.
steps.markdown:
- **One shared explosion system (`@arcade/kit/fx/explosion`)**: 7 typed presets (`grenade`, `propane`, `car`, `barrel`, `missile`, `ship`, `pop`) parameterised by size, energy, fuel, smoke, debris, scorch, flash, and shockwave.
- **Per-game 60 Hz budget (M5 Max Metal, 16.67 ms budget)**:
  - **Getaway** (`960×720`): Single blast GPU mean **0.76 ms** (peak **0.80 ms**) · 4× simultaneous worst-case GPU mean **0.82 ms** (peak **0.89 ms**).
  - **Blackout** (`960×720`): Single blast GPU mean **0.87 ms** (peak **1.03 ms**) · 5× grenade spam worst-case GPU mean **4.86 ms** (peak **6.66 ms**).
  - **Carrier** (`960×720`): Single blast GPU mean **0.38 ms** (peak **0.45 ms**) · 4× simultaneous worst-case GPU mean **0.60 ms** (peak **0.73 ms**).
